title: Round 76 (F382): Map name table verification - TWO name sources differ (mapnames.py legacy-DB: 0=比奇城/1=失乐园; Mapinfo server: 0=比奇县/1=道馆/D001=半兽洞穴1层) + client displays server-pushed name (0x7776A0/0x2F8788 buffer) + 253 link endpoints unnamed in Mapinfo
objective: Verify the map Chinese-name tables: reconcile the mapnames.py (legacy DB) vs Mapinfo.txt (server) name sources, determine client-side usage, and measure naming coverage.
question: Which name table is authoritative, and how do the two sources differ?
method: mapnames.py EXPLICIT table vs /tmp/map_links.json names (Mapinfo); link-endpoint name coverage; client name-buffer usage cross-ref (F331/F333).

name_sources.mapnames_legacy_db: 0=比奇城, 1=失乐园, 2=潘夜村, 3=沙巴克城, 4=诺马村, 10=比奇城堡, 11=道馆; 244 DB maps + 14 legacy (258 total)
name_sources.mapinfo_server: 0=比奇县, 1=道馆, 3=沙巴克城, 01=边境城市, 02=银杏山谷, D001=半兽洞穴1层, D401=废矿矿山入口; 365 names
name_sources.discrepancies: 0.map: 比奇城(DB) vs 比奇县(server); 1.map: 失乐园(DB) vs 道馆(server); D001: 幽灵森林(DB) vs 半兽洞穴1层(server)

cell_analysis.client_usage: client displays map name from server-pushed buffer 0x7776A0/0x2F8788 (F331/F333: packet handler writes); NO client-side name table - both files are secondary evidence
cell_analysis.coverage: 365 named maps / 678 link endpoint refs -> 253 endpoints unnamed in Mapinfo (server names only defined for visited maps)
cell_analysis.api: /api/maps uses mapnames.py legacy names (0=比奇城) - viewer-side choice

exe_trace.name_buffer: 0x7776A0 = hero map-name/group-name slot (F331 dual role; 0x2F8788 = hero+0x20E4 offset)

contrast.legacy_vs_server: legacy DB = community/older naming; Mapinfo = server display names (client shows server's)
contrast.viewer_vs_client: mapviewer uses legacy names; client displays server names

verdict: Map name table verified (secondary evidence): two sources differ (mapnames.py legacy DB vs Mapinfo server); the CLIENT displays the server-pushed name (0x7776A0 buffer, no client-side table), so Mapinfo names are the runtime truth for EI 3.0. Coverage: 365 named, 253 link endpoints unnamed.
evidence_level: secondary (both name tables are server/DB data; client has no name table)
evidence_level_note: Names come from server Mapinfo + legacy DB (secondary per policy); client buffer usage primary-static (F331/F333).
reproduce: compare Tools/maps/mapnames.py EXPLICIT vs /tmp/map_links.json names for 0/1/D001
notes: viewer /api/maps could switch to Mapinfo names for server-accurate display [future]
D001 幽灵森林(DB) vs 半兽洞穴1层(server): server name = what players see
253 unnamed endpoints = maps server never names (interior/instances)
